     salesperson, whoever runs the installation? A capability with no named
     reader is how a first release gets lost, which doc 07's R02 rates Critical. -->

## What blocks it today

<!-- Pick one. The scope register in docs/11 §12 uses these, and which one it is
     usually matters more than the idea itself:

     OEM        needs a manufacturer relationship
     Contract   needs a commercial agreement with a provider
     Market     needs the decision about which market we serve first (D1/D2)
     Decision   needs one of ours (D3, D5) — say which
     Build      needs only engineering time
-->

## Does it change a decision already recorded?

<!-- If it changes an Accepted ADR, say which. Architecture changes are proposed
     as a new dated ADR that supersedes the old one, never as a silent change in
     a pull request (docs/adr/README.md). That is not bureaucracy: the ADRs are
     the only record of WHY, and the code is already the record of what. -->

## What it would take

<!-- A rough shape is enough. If it needs something the product does not have —
     a scheduler, an outbox, a signed job context — say so; several proposals
     have turned out to need the same missing foundation, and that is worth
     knowing before any of them starts. -->
